info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Review Submission API
info.description: The Product Review Submission API allows users to share their experiences and opinions regarding specific products available in the banking channel. Through this endpoint, consumers can submit reviews that provide valuable feedback, helping other customers make informed decisions. This API supports product inventory distribution and is typically utilized by application developers integrating customer feedback features into their platforms. By promoting user engagement, businesses can enhance their product offerings and strengthen customer relationships.

post.summary: Create a review for a product's inventory distribution.
post.description: This endpoint allows the creation of a review for the product inventory distribution specified by the product ID. It enables users to provide feedback and ratings that can aid in improving inventory management and product visibility.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a new review for the product with the identifier PROD-700045. The review should include relevant details such as ratings and comments to provide feedback on the product's performance and quality.
